fields.name: Players
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0x5AB710 ecl::multiplayer::DropInApprovalSystem::UpdateComponents inserts shorts (FrameData+0x90, stride 2) with FUN_18054ED60 and removes shorts (FrameData+0xC0) by hashing (longlong)short % bucket count (+8), keys at +0x20 / size +0x2C and NextIds at +0x10 - a 48-byte HashSet<short>; it then calls the IDropInApprovalHelper slot 0x28 for each approved player. ProcessDisconnections / ProcessAcceptedPlayers look short player ids up in it. Read by ::IsCharacterInSelectorMode and ecl::splitscreen::SplitReasonsSystem::Update (macOS). macOS default: zeroed 48 bytes; live: empty.

second_pass: Confirmed on Windows: bg3.exe+0x1AD4C50 (~UpdateComponents) inserts shorts with FUN_140796C40 and removes them by (longlong)short % buckets (+8) with 2-byte key compares at +0x20 (count +0x2C) in the 0x30-byte singleton - a HashSet<int16_t>.
open_questions: The short is the local player/user number (low half of a UserId); signedness as in the code (short).
live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
